comments.body:
This comes from new r17 Cooking recipe in Amsterdam's Barkeep as Town's man recipe. Need any kind of 17th Century adept of age title to see.

Needs 3x Pork, 3x Sesame Seeds, and 1x Soya Sauce
The good side of this food is it's Fatigue/Vigour Recovery +100 ! But the bad side is you need Soya Sauce which is nanban goods..
